author: Iyuna
quote:
Graphics = They relied on art instead of pure potency (8/10).
Music = Please relesa the soundtrack on Steam! (9/10).
Combat system = Best and most fun to play i have ever seen 11/10).
History = Not the best ever, but keeps you wanting to know what is happening (8.5/10).
Exploration = Just the secondary and world content of this game is better than the 99,9% of the games out there (9/10).

Well, this game not winning GOTY 2024 is a shame,i hope that resumes how good it is to me.
